findings.claim: Linde 10-K FY2025 風險因素列出貿易衝突、關稅與進出口管制為國際營運風險，可能降低需求、售價或營收；法規面亦含貿易進出口限制與經濟制裁。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Linde has substantial international operations which are subject to risks including devaluations in currency exchange rates, transportation delays and interruptions, political and economic instability and disruptions, restrictions on the transfer of 8 Table of Contents funds, trade conflicts and the imposition of duties and tariffs, import and export controls, changes in governmental policies

findings.claim: 搜尋未發現針對 Linde 的實體清單或出口管制行動；2026 年搜尋結果僅見中國對美／歐其他實體的一般性出口管制名單擴大，未提及 Linde。
findings.source: WebSearch: Linde China export control OR trade restriction 2026（Thomson Reuters OneSource 2026-07-28 等）

note: 未查到 Linde 關稅金額量化；Q2 2026 搜尋摘要未見關稅被列為銷售變動因素（未取得逐字原文）。
